author: cellish
body:
Hi there!
This is kinda a new version of Mars, although Mars did very well at the beggining, but later on ppl left and then more and more, so we decided to make a new team that we call "Twix"

Minimun Requirements

  • At least 2 weeks of playing on Avicus or OCN/Lifeboat
  • At least 100 monuments broken/wools placed on Avicus or OCN/Lifeboat
  • At least 5000 Kills in overall on Avicus or OCN/Lifeboat
  • Not going to mention k/d becuase of that people who played when they were younger were maybe bad and died alot and got lots of deaths so that its hard to get good k/d back again.
  • You need to have access for both Teamspeak and Skype.
  • You have to be able to do scrimmages in the timezone GMT +1
How To Apply
  • Skype username: 
  • Timezone:
  • Age (not needed)
  • Position -s
  • Serious during scrims and tourneys?
  • Experience of Avicus and OCN/Lifeboat (Teams and tourneys)
  • Youtube channel (if you have one)
  • Anything else?
